summary: Iteration 11 — full e2e test of the invoice PDF/print/email/settings-customisation work. Backend: 13/14 pytest cases pass (new settings fields, public logo endpoint, invoice email endpoint, regression on invoice lifecycle / reminders / conflicts). Frontend: verified via Playwright on the preview URL — Settings new controls save+persist, logo renders (data-URI in PDF, no broken icon), PDF download works with NO page shrink/reflow (scrollHeight & scrollWidth identical before/during/after, page stays interactive), email dialog prefill + validation + success toast, bulk ZIP now contains real .pdf files with a live progress label, small 12px NL plate, SEPA QR + payment details block, QR-off toggle honoured, header alignment honoured, and the whole flow re-verified in Arabic RTL. Two real defects found (email metadata stripped by response_model; currency-symbol-position setting is a no-op) plus i18n gaps on /invoices.

minor.issue: last_emailed_at / last_emailed_to are written to Mongo by POST /api/invoices/{id}/email (verified directly in DB) but are STRIPPED from the API response because GET /api/invoices uses response_model=List[Invoice] and the Invoice model (server.py ~1063) does not declare these two fields. The requested acceptance criterion 'GET /api/invoices shows last_emailed_at/last_emailed_to' therefore fails. Fix: add last_emailed_at: Optional[str] = None and last_emailed_to: Optional[str] = None to the Invoice model.

ui_bugs.issue: Setting is saved/persisted (invoice_currency_symbol_pos) but has NO effect anywhere: invoice-render.js and the /settings live preview both use formatEUR() which always renders the suffix form ('10,50 €'). With 'Prefix — € 12.50' selected the printed/PDF invoice still shows the suffix. Dead setting.

issues: Page is almost entirely untranslated: heading 'Invoices', 'New invoice', 'Excel', 'All PDFs · ZIP', 'Remind 1 overdue', table headers (Invoice #, Customer, Lines, Total, Status, Created, Actions), status pills (Due, Overdue, NOTICE 3 · FINAL, Paid) and the customer balance card (Owes / Paid lifetime / 'x invoices') all stay in English while the sidebar is Arabic.
Subtitle renders as 'invoices · 164,56 € outstanding 3' in RTL — the count is pushed to the wrong end; wrap the number+word in a bdi/span with dir=ltr.
Email invoice dialog is English-only (title, 'Recipient email', 'Subject', 'Message (optional)', 'Send email', toasts).
Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription for a11y (also affects the New-invoice dialog).

action_items: Add last_emailed_at / last_emailed_to Optional[str] fields to the Invoice Pydantic model so GET /api/invoices exposes them (currently silently dropped).
Make invoice_currency_symbol_pos actually work: pass it into the money formatter used by invoice-render.js (and the /settings live preview) or remove the control.
i18n: translate the /invoices page strings + email dialog for Arabic and fix the RTL number placement in the 'N invoices · X outstanding' subtitle.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the email + new-invoice dialogs to clear the Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: GET /api/invoices response_model=List[Invoice] acts as an allow-list — any new field persisted by a write endpoint must be added to the model or it disappears from the API (root cause of the last_emailed_* bug).

invoice-render.js correctly inlines the logo as a base64 data URI (fetch credentials:'omit' against the now-public /api/settings/logo-file), which is why the logo appears in both print and html2canvas output — keep this behaviour if the endpoint is ever re-secured.
pdf.js off-screen iframe approach is sound: verified no layout jitter on the parent document; iframe is removed in a finally block so no DOM leak after 3+ consecutive exports.
invoice-zip.js swallows per-invoice errors with an empty catch — a failed invoice is silently omitted from the ZIP with no user feedback; consider surfacing a toast listing skipped invoice numbers.
SEPA payload follows EPC069-12 field order (BCD/002/1/SCT/BIC/name/IBAN/EUR amount/.../reference) and QR renders at 179x179 — structurally valid; not machine-scanned in this run.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 scenarios; only the currency-symbol-position customisation failed)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data kept. Test artifacts: uploaded a 1x1 TEST_logo.png via POST /api/settings/logo to validate the public logo endpoint, then restored settings.logo_url to /logo-shawish.png. Settings left as: bank_name='ING Bank', bic='INGBNL2A', iban=NL91ABNA0417164300, invoice_show_qr=true, invoice_header_align='left', invoice_currency_symbol_pos='suffix'. Invoice INV-260821-F798 now carries last_emailed_to=test@example.com. A TEST_ customer + transaction + invoice created in the lifecycle regression test were deleted.
test_credentials: admin@garage.com / admin123 (owner) — valid, login returns {token, user}
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this iteration: PDF shrink bug is FIXED (body scrollHeight/scrollWidth 1080/1920 unchanged before, during and after export in both LTR and Arabic RTL; New-invoice dialog still opens right after export). Bulk ZIP 'PDFs · ZIP (2)' produced invoices-2026-08-22.zip containing 2 real .pdf files (138KB/139KB, no .html) and flipped to a '1/2...' progress label. Print popup inspection is the cheapest way to assert PDF content: page.context.expect_page() on invoice-print-{number}, then evaluate on the popup (logo naturalWidth>0, plate font-size 12px with rgb(255,201,0) bg, 'Scan to pay' present only when invoice_show_qr=true, 'Payment details' + IBAN/BIC/bank/reference always present when iban set). Remaining open items: Invoice model missing last_emailed_* fields, dead currency-symbol-position setting, /invoices Arabic i18n gaps.
rca_of_the_issue: last_emailed_* bug: POST /api/invoices/{id}/email does update Mongo (confirmed by direct motor query: {'last_emailed_at': '2026-08-22T17:11:03+00:00', 'last_emailed_to': 'test@example.com'}), but FastAPI serialises the list response through response_model=List[Invoice]; since Invoice has no such fields, Pydantic drops them. Currency-pos bug: invoice_currency_symbol_pos is only read in Settings.jsx form state; invoice-render.js formats every amount with formatEUR() and never consults it.
